about: Hand-curated half of the seam map: what code can't tell us. Keys match the app folders in the generated JSON. Keep factual; mark unknowns as null + an entry in `gaps`. Render with: node scripts/seam-map/render.mjs

ima-dai.label: Google IMA / DAI client SDK
ima-dai.shape: The app's player asks Google's IMA SDK (client-side) or DAI (server-stitched pods) for ad breaks. The ad schedule surfaces in Java/Kotlin as cue points, ad-break lists or an AdsManager.
ima-dai.portable_seams: Empty the cue-point / ad-break accessor; neuter AdsManager.start; null the SSAI AdsLoader getter; redirect live pods to a slate. Seams found in one IMA app usually port to the next (Fox One = Tubi-class).

ssai-manifest.label: Server-side stitching (SSAI) via manifest
ssai-manifest.shape: The CDN stitches ads into the stream itself. The only client-visible trace is the manifest (ad periods, DateRanges, ID3/beacon tags) and the host names that serve it.
ssai-manifest.portable_seams: Force a clean manifest (origin block, CDN fallback, ad-free URL swap); strip ad periods; or, for live passthrough SSAI, detect the break and MASK it (slate + mute).

proprietary.label: Proprietary native / JS ad engine
proprietary.shape: The ad decision lives in the app's own runtime — a native library, a JS VM inside a .so, or a WebView — not in a standard SDK.
proprietary.portable_seams: Find where the ad schedule crosses into the player (a response buffer, a JS function, an insertion-point accessor) and empty it there; native seams need re-pointing per version.

primevideo.runtime: libignite = WAMR AoT WASM runtime; player/timeline in QuickJS. v16 (6.24.x) moved the whole ad pipeline native (Java ad surface gone); the Megablast Rust ad client is a DOWNLOADED .so.br blob, updatable server-side.
primevideo.delivery: Client-stitched: the app fetches an ad schedule (regolith / SGAI `getVideoAds` response, intraTitlePlaylist) and stitches ad pods into playback itself.
primevideo.seam: The regolith ad-playlist response inside libignite — intercepted by a native GOT/PLT hook (memcpy) and emptied; intraTitlePlaylist PATH1 skipped.
primevideo.action: Empty the ad playlist before the player sees it → the break is never scheduled.
primevideo.patch_evidence: `[rego] emptied playlist (~N ad(s), interior X bytes blanked)` + `PVKILL path=tv ads=N` at the moment each pod is fetched (2026-09-24 live: 1 pre-roll, 4 + 3 mid-roll ads emptied).
primevideo.device_signature: When an ad DOES play (6.24.7 capture): decoder reconfigure (`Discard frames from previous generation`, `VideoResolutionChange`) + crop switch (title-specific, e.g. letterbox 960 → ad 1080) + ~27 `I/f Successfully uploaded metrics` in ~2 s from the app process. With the patch working: none of these at the marker, 0 metrics uploads.
primevideo.drift: v16 loader never fired because onCreate became `public final` vs an exact accessFlags match (fix: drop accessFlags). 6.24.7 = minor bump, seam re-pointed (declared target still in progress). High-ad-region mid-roll truncation (#120) fixed in v1.37.4.
gaps: Timeline-action native symbols unresolved (Native_StartTimelineAction not in NativeSymbol table).

netflix.delivery: Ad metadata is produced and consumed in the app's JavaScript layer.
netflix.seam: `getAdMetadata` in the JS bundle (wildcard MASTER re-anchor), plus the ad-kill script.
netflix.action: Strip ad metadata so no ad is scheduled; household prompt handled separately (opt-in).
netflix.drift: Anchor drift on 13.0.1 (re-anchored at getAdMetadata); #166 re-minify drift fixed v1.36.0 (wildcard MASTER) and v1.37.1. Household prompt is a TIMING wall for string patches — needs a load-hook.
gaps: No runtime log line proves the seam fired — add one.

disney.runtime: Disney media player (legacy DSS SDK and new com.disney.dmp).
disney.delivery: SGAI (server-guided ad insertion): the player receives insertion points / ranges that say where ads go.
disney.action: Return empty insertion points/ranges → no breaks scheduled. 26.16: obfuscated MEL pause layer → pause ad made optional.
disney.drift: Verified through 26.12.1; 26.16 pause-ad needed an optional patch (#167).

hbomax.delivery: SSAI: ads stitched server-side; manifests from media.max.com / gmss / fwmrm (FreeWheel).
hbomax.seam: Network origins (in-app block on media.max.com/gmss/fwmrm → clean `_fallback.mpd`) and the CDN-fallback coordinator (`isUsingAlternateCdn()` → true).
hbomax.action: Force the ad-free fallback manifest; Prefer Ad-Free Stream fixes the mid-roll 39999 fatal.
hbomax.drift: 7.5.12 package rename; 7.7.0.78 dynamic-register fix (P2). Household prompt = server-side ExtraMember wall (not bytecode-beatable).
gaps: Keep the opt-in origin-block OFF (fatals mid-roll).

paramount.delivery: VOD: client ad decision. Live: full-service IMA-DAI → one stitched stream (no CDN-fallback seam).
paramount.action: VOD: shouldPlayAd → false. Live: pure slate-redirect (accepted ceiling — in-interceptor PTS alignment crashed weak hardware).
paramount.drift: 16.17 ANR fixed in v1.19.0; fingerprints hardened for 16.19.

pluto.runtime: Paramount's AVIA player (AviaPlayer.startExoplayer) over media3/ExoPlayer; Pluto stitcher sessions.
pluto.delivery: SSAI via Pluto's stitcher: VOD sessions carry ad breaks; live streams carry ID3 ad beacons.
pluto.seam: VOD: `StitcherSession.getAdBreaks()` + DASH ad-period strip + beacon/pause/clickable-ad binders. Live: `ID3AdsBeaconTracker.consumeID3` as the break DETECTOR.
pluto.action: VOD: remove ad breaks entirely. Live: mask the break (black cover + mute), lifted when the show returns.
pluto.patch_evidence: `muteStream: OK` + `muteExo: OK` + `showCover` + `live ad break -> mask ON (mode=BOTH)` ~0.1 s after the first beacon; `live ad break -> mask OFF (last ad ended (QUARTILE_END, no next ad))` ~1.2 s after the last ad's QUARTILE_END (6.5 s no-tick fallback remains) (tag MORPHE-PLUTO-SLATE).
pluto.device_signature: Live (2026-09-24 captures, 5.66.0): the app's OWN verbose log `V/ID3AdsBeaconTracker consumeID3: ID3Tag(creativeId=…, currentIndexSec=N, maximumIndexSec=30|15, typeFlags=[…])` every ~5 s per ad; `START_OF_MEDIA` = ad start, `QUARTILE_END` = ad end, creativeId changes per ad, next ad starts 80–104 ms after the previous QUARTILE_END. A decoder re-init at each splice. NOT a signature: resolution changes — HLS adaptive bitrate switches 720/360 all the time without ads.
pluto.drift: #144 fixed (positive ad-detect + <40% guard); #147 resume fixed; #152 live mask shipped, mute fixed v1.35.1.

espn.runtime: ESPN player (MediaPlayerViewModel) with passthrough SSAI on live.
espn.delivery: Live: passthrough SSAI, breaks marked by DateRanges in the manifest. VOD: client flag.
espn.seam: Live: DateRanges × playhead → break detector. VOD: `isAdDisabled`. `ProgramData.eventId` feeds the scoreboard slate.
espn.action: Live: mask (animated slate + mute). VOD: ads disabled.
espn.drift: onProgramData needs an R8 -keep or NoSuchMethodError bounces live games.

mlbtv.delivery: Live: Google DAI pod serving (same shape as Paramount live).
mlbtv.action: Redirect live ad pods to a slate.

peacock.runtime: Peacock player with WebView + XTV client + OkHttp networking.
peacock.seam: Manifest URL (`/dai/pub/` → `/pub/`), XTV client setters, OkHttp builder.
peacock.action: Swap to the ad-free manifest path; block ad hosts in OkHttp.

tubi.delivery: Client-side ad decisions through the Fox SDK.
tubi.seam: SDK ad hooks 1/2/3/5/6 (per-version R8 class renames).
tubi.action: Skip ads at the SDK boundary.
tubi.drift: R8 renames classes each version → per-version re-pin map (10.28.5000 shipped; newer re-pins in progress).

foxone.runtime: Same Fox IMA-DAI SDK as Tubi.
foxone.seam: Tubi hooks 1/2/3/5/6 are near drop-in; auto-skip-by-seek (dispatchAdPodStart + seekTo) explored.

rte.action: Empty cue points; neuter AdsManager.start. ⚠️ Neutering onAdsManagerLoaded HANGS.

vix.action: Empty cues; clone to avoid keystore mismatch.
vix.drift: Device's ViX key ≠ CLI key → uninstall or clone.

twitchatv.runtime: Starshot WebView player (Android TV build only).
twitchatv.delivery: HLS with server-inserted ad segments + X-TV-TWITCH-AD-* signal tags; native IVS pre-roll.
twitchatv.action: Blank-substitute ad segments with PTS smoothing (the client ceiling; zero-ads blocked by native pre-roll).
twitchatv.drift: v9.0.0 is a native ExoPlayer build that predates Starshot → incompatible (#164).
